acceptedAnswer.text: High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) is a training method that alternates short bursts of intense anaerobic exercise with brief periods of low-intensity recovery. This approach aims to maximize calorie burn and improve cardiovascular fitness in a shorter amount of time compared to traditional steady-state cardio. At Cave Training, our HIIT sessions are integrated into a functional fitness framework, focusing on movements that prepare your body for real-world activities. We emphasize proper form and progressive overload to ensure safety and effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: HIIT is a training method that combines short bursts of intense exercise with brief recovery periods. It's designed to improve fitness and burn calories efficiently.
